what: Pre-existing worktree draft stub assuming NCT07275905 (AchromoPhage) registers a primary sputum Achromobacter CFU/mL density endpoint
why: Refuted by raw tools/trial_atlas/snapshot.json and ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 protocolSection: NCT07275905 registers Phase 1 primary safety ('Incidence of treatment-related Grade >=4 adverse events or treatment-limiting toxicities' through Day 42) and secondary AchromoPhage qPCR concentration across serum, sputum, nasal swabs, and oral swabs; bacterial CFU/mL density is not stated in outcomesModule.

what: Primary-outcome-only PRISMA-940 baseline classifier evaluated across the fixed 20-study CF infection and diagnostic benchmark
why: Achieved only 5/20 (0.2500) joint exact-match accuracy: missed NCT04294043 (ABATE IV gallium NTM, excluded from PRISMA-940 by X4 because conditions lists only Nontuberculous Mycobacterium Infection), missed external OBSERVATIONAL NCT07312734 (SEND-CF), missed non-CF X5 control NCT05616221, and could not identify pathogen/modality focus on trials whose primary outcome names safety, FEV1, or general bacterial culture without naming the pathogen/modality.

what: Round 1 draft taxonomy merging IV gallium (NCT02354859 IGNITE) with NTM, labeling inhaled tobramycin eradication (NCT00391976 ELITE) as non-sputum diagnostic sampling, and reading Dayman et al. 2026 'Nine face mask samples from 11 participants' as 9/11 participants
why: Caught by Round 1 blind diff review against snapshot.json and PMC13061336: NCT02354859 enrolled CF P. aeruginosa (zero NTM), NCT00391976 is a P. aeruginosa antibiotic eradication RCT, Dayman et al. collected paired pre/post-clearance masks so 9 is a mask-sample count rather than a participant count, and quarantine needed pre-bidi neutralization plus Greek/fullwidth confusables.
